job.name: hist_toon_b
job.meaning: рисованный молодой мужчина-рассказчик: тёмная аккуратная борода, вязаный свитер горчичного цвета и шарф, деревянная библиотека у окна
job.prompt: A young man storyteller about 32 with tousled dark hair and a neat short beard, a mustard knitted sweater and a teal wool scarf. Background: a warm wooden library with tall shelves of closed old books, a window with golden afternoon light and a globe, softly blurred. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders fully inside the frame, centred, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large, looking straight at the viewer, mid-sentence with lips slightly parted as if telling an exciting story, calm friendly expression, NO broad smile, hands relaxed and out of the frame or low. ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, writing or scribbles anywhere (books are closed or pages blank, no chalkboard), no watermark, no signature.
job.style: Warm painterly storybook digital illustration, like a frame from a modern hand-painted animated film for adults: soft visible brushwork, slightly stylised but believable proportions, expressive friendly eyes, rosy cheeks, warm golden window light, cosy nostalgic atmosphere, rich warm palette of honey, cream, olive green, muted teal and rosewood, soft shadows, fine detail. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D plastic CGI, NOT anime, NOT flat vector.
job.style_qa: тёплая живописная «сказочная» цифровая иллюстрация, как кадр рисованного мультфильма для взрослых: мягкие мазки, слегка стилизованные, но правдоподобные пропорции, тёплый золотой свет, уютная ностальгическая атмосфера
